text:
May I introduce myself - Tess Vale the Riddler.
I enjoy challenging people with short, yet difficult riddles.
zh:
请容我自我介绍——谜语师苔丝·维尔。
我喜欢用简短却难解的谜语来考验人们。

text: Care to test your mind with a riddle?
zh: 想用一道谜语试试你的头脑吗？

text:
What about you?
Care to try one?
zh:
你呢？
想来试一道吗？

text: Sure! Test me with your riddle.
zh: 当然！用你的谜语考考我吧。

text: Test me with your riddle. (5 Gold)
zh: 用你的谜语考考我吧。（5金币）

text: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What am I?
zh: 你迈出得越多，身后留下的就越多。我是什么？

text:
I'm sorry, that's not the answer.
Do you want me to repeat the riddle?
zh:
很遗憾，答案不对。
要我把谜语再说一遍吗？

没问题！
我就在这里。

text:
If you'd like, I can give you more riddles.
But it'll cost you a little.
zh:
如果你愿意，我还有更多谜语给你。
不过要收一点费用。

text: Feel free to come back whenever you're ready.
zh: 准备好了随时回来找我。

text: If you only had enough gold...

Feed me and I live, give me water and I die.
What am I?
zh:
喂我食物，我便存活；给我水喝，我便死去。
我是什么？

text:
I'm sorry, that's not the answer.
Do you want me to repeat the riddle?
zh:
很遗憾，答案不对。
要我把谜语再说一遍吗？

text: Feel free to come back whenever you're ready for a new riddle.
zh: 想挑战新谜语的时候，随时回来找我。

text: What's the name of this Inn?
What's the name of the king's advisor?
zh: 国王的顾问叫什么名字？

text: I have a face but no eyes. Hands but no arms. What am I?
zh: 我有一张脸，却没有眼睛；有一双手，却没有臂膀。我是什么？
我上次碰到的那个强盗。

text:
Uhm... what the fuck? No!
Do you want me to repeat the riddle?
zh:
呃……搞什么鬼？不对！
要我把谜语再说一遍吗？

text: I follow you everywhere, but you can never touch me. What am I?
zh: 我处处跟随着你，你却永远碰不到我。我是什么？

text:
Sorry, I just ran out of riddles.
Give me some time to think about a new one.
zh:
抱歉，我的谜语刚好用完了。
给我点时间，让我再想一道新的。
